roundTwo.1_verifyBeforeExtract: restore decrypts and authenticates into a temp tar inside the destination root first; extraction runs only after the tag verified; scratch-roundtrip.ts: wrong key, wrong bee id and wrong epoch all refuse with nothing extracted
roundTwo.2_keyId: header is hbrb2 | keyId(8) | salt | nonce; rows carry key_id; a local key with another id is key_mismatch with both ids; an enrolled node never mints a key (key_unavailable reason=enrolled_node_expects_provisioned_key); the unchanged check includes the key id so a key change re-bundles
roundTwo.3_exitedImmediate: requestSync(beeId, 'exited') cancels a pending trailing timer and bundles now
roundTwo.4_torn: state files are fingerprinted (path, size, mtime) before and after the tar; a changed set is discarded as torn and retried at the next turn end
roundTwo.nits: AAD is <beeId>|<epoch>; the contract notes claude todos/ and file-history/ are not bundled

leadItemsFromH6bReview.1_homeKeyStrip: fixed: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME, GROK_HOME, KIMI_HOME, MUSE_HOME, HOME and the harness's own key are stripped from descriptor.env unconditionally; the bundle restores into the resolved account home or the cwd
leadItemsFromH6bReview.2_fenceRule: fixed in the contract and the wire: the Home is the only legal caller, bee.fence precedes bee.import, imports of one bee are serialised by the Home, the import carries fence {epoch, fencedAt} and returns unfenced: true (plus a log line) when it is missing
leadItemsFromH6bReview.3_reseedImplemented: fixed: reseedImportedBee is real (above); resumed=reseeded occurs (resume-reseed.1)
leadItemsFromH6bReview.4_cellWip: fixed: descriptor.cell carries wipSha + wipTree; the import adopts the WIP commit under this node's ref scope (adoptWipRef), records it confirmed on the new registry row, and resolveCell restores it on the first provisioning (not only after an eviction); resume-import-cell.1 proves notes.md comes back in B's fresh Cell with ignored output absent; wipRestore: adopted | unreachable in the result
leadItemsFromH6bReview.5_bootFailed: implemented: native imports are remembered until their first turn end; a spawn failure before that clears the fork seed, re-seeds from the import's transcript when given, records {resumed, reason: boot_failed} under bee.import.boot_failed:<bee>:<gen> and revives a flagged bee; not exercised by a test (the stub never fails to boot) and the memory does not survive a daemon restart (documented)
leadItemsFromH6bReview.6_mailReplay: fixed in the contract: only pending (undelivered) rows are replayed by the Home; lost.questions are withdrawn by the Home

h6cReview.3_adoptWipRefParent: fixed: adoptWipRef adopts only when the origin has the commit and sha^ equals the Cell's sha; otherwise wipRestore reports unreachable or parent_mismatch and nothing is recorded as confirmed

roundTwo.h5Takeover: fixed: champion.start with homeRef + an epoch not older than the row on a node that still binds a stale incarnation takes over: epoch+1, fence cleared, the stale bee stopped/archived/unbound (replacedBeeId), the non-empty home set aside as <home>.stale-<epoch>-<ts> and the bundle restored before the new incarnation spawns (started: spawned, homeRestored: true); plain starts on a bound node revive as before and on a fenced row stay champion_fenced; every start reports restoreSkipped (home_not_empty | no_bundle | stale_epoch | restore_failed | home_sync_off | null). champions.1 drives the round trip A -> B -> A: A takes epoch 2, seen.txt from B's home is present, the old home is set aside, the stale incarnation is archived
